integrity: The counterexample has a direct finite proof. Minimality below length 8 is proved structurally, and the complete length-8 census is reproduced by the bundled exhaustive verifier. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exhaustive classification is restricted to the shortest failing length 8; no count or asymptotic statement is made for longer words. Originality remains subject to unindexed or unpublished observations.
title: Shortest counterexamples to the ternary dihedral shuffle-square conjecture
